basics.name: Yuliang Yan
basics.label: PhD Student in Artificial Intelligence
basics.summary: PhD student at HKUST (GZ), supervised by Enyan Dai. Research focuses on AI for Protein, de novo drug design, and trustworthy large language models.

education.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

work.name: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
highlights: Lead the design and evaluation of training algorithms for reaction condition recommendation using LLMs, including dataset construction and cleaning. The proposed framework can directly generate plausible chemical reaction conditions with high accuracy.

Contributed to the DPO training of a chemistry-specific LLM for improved alignment with domain preferences, including both dataset construction and training algorithm development. Participated in the publication of research on ChemLLM during the internship.
